mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in Mississauga?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. Lots near the Credit River may also need Credit Valley Conservation review. We check before you order.

mainEntity.name: My property backs onto a ravine. Can I have a sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, yes. We place the sauna away from the top of the slope and suggest confirming with Credit Valley Conservation if you're inside its regulated area.

mainEntity.name: Can I see the saunas before buying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Visit our showroom at 17380 Highway 27, Schomberg, by appointment.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Mississauga?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Mississauga. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
